# Reverend Jo

- **Age:** Young man  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>
- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>
- **Titles:** Rev.  <sub>[v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)</sub>; Reverend  <sub>[v4 c3 P9](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0009), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Jonas  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012)</sub>; Jo  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Jonas is described as a very ugly young man with a big, loose-jointed figure and absurdly long legs. He has lank, tow-colored hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and noticeable ears. On his wedding day, his happiness made him radiant enough that no one considered him plain.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039)_

## Personality

Jonas is friendly, agreeable, and naturally welcoming, often smiling at others as if he has known them all his life. He possesses a jovial demeanor, frequently laughing and joking, which makes him a favorite among many, though some older women disapprove of his frivolous banter. He is dedicated and serious about his calling as a minister.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012)_

## History

Jonas Blake was a theological student from St. Columbia who previously graduated from Redmond College. While studying, he took charge of the Point Prospect Mission Church for a summer, where he met Philippa Gordon and quickly became close friends with her. Although he resisted entering the ministry for a long time, he eventually accepted it as his divine calling. He frequently visited Patty's Place while traveling from St. Columbia and became a general favorite there. After proposing to Philippa, he visited her home at Mount Holly and won over her parents despite initial reservations from her mother. Upon graduating from St. Columbia, he took charge of a small mission church on Patterson Street in the slums and married Philippa Gordon. Later, Jonas attended the wedding of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe, where he offered a prayer praised by Mrs. Rachel Lynde, before residing in Kingsport with his wife.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c25 P12](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0012), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c27 P29](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0029), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c39 P39](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0039), [v4 c3 P43](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0043), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016), [v4 c22 P20](../source/v04-c22.md#nw-v04-c22-p0020)_
